The licence is as Commons records it. Identified as this saint because: Plate 02201 of the Russian Lives of the Saints (1903-1911), whose numbering puts it on 20 October - the folder's feast day. Captioned Artemy and filed under Category:Icons of Artemius of Antioch, the dux of Egypt martyred at Antioch under Julian. The next plate on the same day, 02202, is Artemy of Verkola, a 16th-century Russian boy - that near-namesake was the trap here and the category settles it. Commons describes it: Иллюстрации к книге: Жития святых на русском языке, изложенные по руководству Четьих-Миней  с дополнениями, объяснительными примечаниями и изображениями святых
